Title: Immortal Graple and Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws? 4 LSJ

Messages.Author: pittboo
Messages.Body:
If A Minion w/ Sup POT plays Immortal Graple. Can that mionio strike with
Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws.

If the same Minion plays Torn Signpost and has Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws.
will he have 5 hand damage.

One more. If that same minion starts off combat by playing Increased
Strength +2 to POT Cards.
Then he plays Torn Signpost is his hand damage 5?
He also adds Fist of Death for +2 whould that be +4?
That minion strikes with Undead Strength for +2 whould that also be +4.
So that minion would strike for 13 hand damage right?
Droz

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
"pittboo" <pit...@olypen.com> wrote:
> If A Minion w/ Sup POT plays Immortal Graple. Can that mionio strike with
> Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws.

...as has been covered a billion times before, melee weapons may not be
used with Immortal Grapple. IG specifies "hand strikes" and using a melee
weapon is not a "hand strike".

> If the same Minion plays Torn Signpost and has Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws.
> will he have 5 hand damage.

He can do 5 damage as a strike. A melee weapon strike is not "hand damage".
Hand damage is used as a base for figuring damage from a melee weapon.

> One more. If that same minion starts off combat by playing Increased
> Strength +2 to POT Cards.
> Then he plays Torn Signpost is his hand damage 5?
> He also adds Fist of Death for +2 whould that be +4?
> That minion strikes with Undead Strength for +2 whould that also be +4.
> So that minion would strike for 13 hand damage right?

Torn Signpost sets base hand damage to 3
Fists of Death add 2 to base hand damage.
Increased Strength adds 2 damage to Potence STRIKES
Undead Strength is base hand damage +2

(3+2) + (2+2) = 9 damage

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"pittboo" <pit...@olypen.com> wrote:
> If A Minion w/ Sup POT plays Immortal Graple. Can that mionio strike with
> Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws.

No. A Strike with a weapon is not a hand strike, so is not allowed under
Immortal Grapple.

> If the same Minion plays Torn Signpost and has Bang Nakh-Tiger's Claws.
> will he have 5 hand damage.

Not quite. He can strike with the Tiger Claws for 5 damage.

> One more. If that same minion starts off combat by playing Increased
> Strength +2 to POT Cards.
> Then he plays Torn Signpost is his hand damage 5?

No. His hand damage (now called "his strength") is 3 and any potence
strikes he makes will be at +2. Increased Strength only affects potence
strike cards, not potence cards in general.

> He also adds Fist of Death for +2 whould that be +4?

That would make his strength 5 (3+2) and he would still deal an additional
2 damage from any potence strike.

> That minion strikes with Undead Strength for +2 whould that also be +4.

That strike would do strength+2+2 damage.

> So that minion would strike for 13 hand damage right?

Since his strength is 5, the Undead Strength strike would deal 9 damage.
